assembly_notes: Three honest structural slots. Ten source-backed panel families each publish N local selector stations plus an adaptive auxiliary band; four button styles consume every station and five auxiliary styles consume the band. All 10 x 4 x 5 = 200 core combinations build without a compatibility gate. floor_count is N, not core: 6/8/12/18/30 each add one complete numbered selector while the selected host re-derives rows, dimensions, inset capacity and information-module position. The three mechanical selector candidates add a bezel, guide, moving cap and prismatic joint; glass_touch_numbered adds one fixed indexed illuminated cell, preserving its inspected topology. Auxiliary controls use explicit vertical staggering, and destination action wells occupy a separate upper sub-band so controls do not visually overlap neighboring pieces. numeral_style samples six real geometric constructions and never inflates core/raw.
